The '''Mistryl Safehouse''' was a building outside the town of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] world [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. It was used by the [[Mistryl Shadow Guard]], a mercenary organization, as a safe place to stage their operations. Inside the house, the mercenaries from [[Emberlene]] had built a [[Emberlene memorial shrine|memorial shrine]] where they could remember their homeworld and leave offerings. Like most Emberlene memorial shrines it was stocked with [[Emberlene Essence]] that evoked memories of the deep woods of the Mistryl's homeworld.<ref name="SWG:CE" />

Several [[Slicer/Legends|slicers]] worked for the Mistryl at this location. It was guarded by well-armed Mistryl Skirmishers and [[Mistryl Assault Trooper]]s.<ref name="SWG:CE" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] of the [[Azure Cabal]] mercenary organization gained access to the safe house and stole a bottle of Emberlene Essence from the memorial shrine. He then used the essence during an attack on the [[Cult of M'dweshuu]] to blame the Mistryl for the attack.<ref name="SWG:CE" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Mistryl Safehouse was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:CE" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Mistryl Safehouse was added to the game as part of the [[W:c:swg:Azure Cabal|Azure Cabal questline]],<ref name="SWG:CE" /> released with the "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 6 Notes for May 22 2007|Chapter 6]]" update, on [[May 22]], [[2007]].<ref name="Chapter 6">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67250&month=052007|text=Publish Notes &ndash; Chapter 6: Masters of the Wild}}</ref>

This building could be found near the town of Theed, near the edge of the no-build zone around the city that prevents players from placing their houses there.<ref name="SWG:CE" /> The building used is a typical Naboo building known as the "Medium Naboo House," which can also be crafted and owned by players.<ref>{{SonyCite|url=players/guides.vm?id=80006|text=Player Houses: Naboo}}</ref>
